<COMPILE / TEST / HARDWARE>

Rules:
- Inspect first.
- Assess impact.
- Check error/lesson memory if relevant.
- Create checkpoint for risky work.
- Minimal patch only.
- Compile after source changes.
- Inspect git diff/status.
- Preserve user changes.
- Do not use destructive Git commands.
- Do not create duplicate project versions.
- Report only actionable results.

ULTRA SAVE TOKEN (PERMANENT):
- Minimal prompts and output.
- Report only actionable results.
- Never report none/unchanged sections.
- Paths/line numbers only when needed.
- Stop immediately on blocker.
- Never modify source without explicit task scope.
- Compile before upload.
- Upload only after compile PASS.
- Preserve Git baselines.
- Separate Compile-Verified from Hardware-Verified.
- Record errors/lessons to prevent recurrence.
